Mara V: Quick sync — launchpad train tomorrow 13:00 UTC. Need clarity on who owns slot B (model-serving) and slot C (console). Can y'all confirm? :eyes:

Kevin L: I can take slot B but I have a meeting 13:30–13:50 UTC. Can we keep the smoke window to 15m? If anything fails I can be on-call for rollback until 14:00.

Sasha P: I can pair on slot C. I want someone for verification after the smoke tests (metrics + trace sampling) — maybe Priya?

Priya R: Happy to be verification for slot C. Will run the smoke checklist and sanity prompts. What's the smoke command?

Tomas J: deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window 2024-03-01T13:00:00Z -> slot owners required.

Mara V: @Priya quick smoke commands: 
``
# smoke: health + basic gen
curl -sS https://api.redwood.internal/health || exit 1
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"ping"}' | jq .output
```
Run both and confirm latency < 300ms and token errors 0.

Priya R: Got it. I'll run the two checks and paste results in this thread. Planning to do smoke at +5m after slot deploy completes.

Kevin L: slot B plan: rolling to two nodes first, then remaining. Rollback plan: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/model-serving --to-revision=previous` then scale down new replicas, promote old image. I'll post exact commands in the deploy runbook.

Sasha P: FYI I'll watch logs and traces. If we see >2% 5xx or latency p50 jump >200ms we rollback.

Mara V: Can we agree on SLAs for the train? 1) smoke green within 15m, 2) rollback decision by 25m if smoke fails, 3) handoff to oncall if unresolved after 40m.

Kevin L: Agree.

Priya R: Agree. I'll paste smoke outputs right after deploy.

Tomas J: deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled at 1725024680 -> Please annotate runbook with owner tags: slot-b:KevinL slot-c:SashaP verifier:PriyaR

Mara V: Thanks — assigning owners in the release doc. Everyone, please ack this thread when you see it. :thumbsup:

Kevin L: ack

Sasha P: ack

Priya R: ack

Tomas J: deploy-bot: Noted. Entry added to launchpad calendar.
